the keeper desk

the people who make sure we get it right.

every lesson in infinite hill is written by us and read by a Keeper before it's recorded. a Keeper is a scholar of that tradition: someone who has spent their career studying its texts, and whom people inside it and outside it respect. some are also ordained. what they share is that they know the sources, and they can say no. one desk per door, plus a science seat that checks every number we put on a page.

what a keeper does

reads every session. flags what's wrong, too early, too much, or not theirs. sends it back. we fix it or we cut it. the Keeper's job is "is it right," not "is it solemn" — if a lesson is accurate and a kid laughs, that's a pass.

what a keeper can do that we can't

veto. a Keeper can pull a lesson from their door and we can't overrule it. that goes in every Keeper's contract, not just the brochure.

what a keeper never does

sell anything. Keepers are paid a flat fee by infinite hill and hold no revenue upside from their door. nobody on a desk will ever be asked to promote plus, the table, a gift, or an event.

who's on it

the names and faces shown on this site are the people we are asking — not people who have said yes. nothing on infinite hill is signed until it's signed, and we'll say so plainly the day it is.

want to help us get it right?

if you teach, lead, or study a faith and think we've got something wrong, thank you. we really want to hear it. see Contact.

start now. it's free.
